$Comment: Names the factor Christmas_Tomas_Key for lock lines on a server without MMO Skill Tree, where his
apprentice quest is the one key: a player who has not finished it reads 'Requires finishing Tomas's
Apprentice' on his loaf recipe. Factor names the factor this file names (it defines no value of its
own), and Text.TitleKey is the full lang key: the lang file's name, a dot, then the key as written in
Requires, the plain hytale:mod_installed condition with Max 0, drops this file at load where MMO Skill
Tree is installed; Mmo_Christmas_Tomas_Key_Name.json, gated with Min 1, names the factor there instead,
with the skill level too. Each server loads exactly one of the two.
